title: Claimant's Election of an Estate's Later Pass-Through Allocations — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) System Card
content:
# Claimant's Election of Later Pass-Through Allocations for an Estate

*Member information system reference — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).*

## Rule

A wholesale-supplier pass-through allocation booked to a deceased member's capital account after the estate's retirement was approved is retired for the estate only on the estate claimant's own election, one election entry for each such allocation, up to the class's estate annual cap of gross estate retirement in the calendar year; a pass-through allocation the claimant does not elect stays in the general rotation.

Each elected row is booked as one special retirement entry with retirement type estate for its gross, together with one payable entry for the payable the claimant accepts, and the gross is the pass-through amount of that year less every general retirement already booked on it.

## What the election records

A later pass-through allocation is one whose wholesale-supplier allocation entry on the deceased member's account is dated after the board approval date of the estate's retirement request. One election, for one such allocation:

- records a special retirement entry of the estate type, source wholesale-supplier pass-through, for the gross allocated amount;
- records the matching payable entry for the amount the claimant accepts for the estate, net of the discount;
- lowers the unretired credits by the gross and raises the retired credits owed by the payable.

The claimant sees the accepted amount owed to the estate. An allocation the claimant declines is left unretired and stays in the general rotation; declining leaves no entry.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `elect_estate_passthrough_retirement_e31dc75a`, a tool owned by the claimant. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves — here the estate's claimant — runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`. The election is the claimant's own act.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `capital_account_id` | reference number of the deceased member's capital credit account, from the capital credit account lookup, as the agent reads it to the claimant | identifier |
| `capital_request_id` | reference number of the estate's approved estate retirement request, from the capital credit request lookup, as the agent reads it to the claimant | identifier |
| `allocation_year` | the patronage year of the pass-through allocation elected, as on the allocation entry | four digits, YYYY |
| `gross_retired_amount` | the allocated pass-through amount being retired | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `payable_amount` | the discounted amount the claimant accepts for the estate | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

The source is always recorded as `gt_allocation`; it is not a parameter.

### Return

A successful call returns `status` "elected", `retirement_entry_id`, `payable_entry_id`, `allocation_year` (YYYY), `allocation_source` (always `gt_allocation`), `gross_retired_amount`, `discount_amount` and `payable_amount` (USD, 2 decimals), and the account's new `unretired_balance` and `payable_balance` (USD, 2 decimals). The election succeeded when the status is elected.
